name: silver-skills
title_zh: 九件套工具箱，每件都卡在你最疼的那个动作上
tagline_zh: 不是堆功能，是九把刀。每把只解决一个具体到发指的场景：从剪贴板到日历，从报价单到复盘，装完就能用，不装就难受。
tagline_en: Not a feature dump—nine blades. Each one targets one painfully specific moment: clipboard to calendar, quote.
why_zh: 它不追求大而全，而是把每个技能磨到单点极致。你不需要翻文档猜意图，每个动作都像有人替你预判了下一步。
why_en: It doesn't chase breadth—it sharpens each skill to a single-point edge. No doc-reading, no guesswork; every step feels.
limit_zh: 只覆盖九种场景，超出即停。无统一配置面板，各技能独立生效，需自行阅读每个技能的 README 才能知道它到底管哪一段。
limit_en: Covers exactly 9 scenarios, nothing more. No unified config; each skill works standalone. You must read each README to learn its exact scope.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 9 skills, each aimed at your most painful move
